listing.name: Balanced Commerce
listing.summary: This mod changes the Commerce industry to be more balanced and convenient:
listing.aiSummary: Changes the Commerce industry into a structure to balance bonuses and save industry slots.

description:
The problem with vanilla commerce
It is well-known that Commerce is potentially a very unbalanced industry. It can give +125% colony income (example 1, example 2). On top of that, players are forced to use an industry slot for Commerce just so they can have a market on a colony in which they can sell their loot.

What this mod does
This mod changes the Commerce industry to be more balanced and convenient:

Spoiler

With it, you can have more reasonable, realistic bonuses and penalties from commerce, and have it be a structure instead of an industry - saving an industry slot, and letting you have a market on each of your colonies without sacrificing an industry.
I tested the mod with these settings in my playthroughs, and they felt reasonable, balanced and realistic.

You can choose your own desired income bonuses and stability penalties from commerce through Lunalib settings:

Spoiler

Requirements:
Lunalib

Download link:
https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1bBAgq6uTLWkAdNTLVFVxlJHFFj8VFTpL&export=download

Questions & answers:

Spoiler
Can this mod be added to an existing game?
Yes.

Does it work with Ashes of the Domain?
Yes.

Does it work with Industrial Evolution?
It should work if you disable Industrial Evolution's changes to Commerce through its Lunalib settings.

Which game versions is this mod compatible with?
Made for 0.98a-RC8. It is very likely to remain compatible after subsequent Starsector updates.

Credits:

Spoiler
Wyvern - When making this mod, I initially used the scripts from Planetary Shield - Access Control as examples. This was suggested in this thread by Wyvern, the author of the mod, some time ago to another user who also felt that Commerce required changes.
